summary: Verified new customer REFUND RECEIPT layout (gst_invoice_service.build_refund_html) and routing in invoice_html_service.build_invoice_html via pytest. 8/8 unit tests pass covering: refund HTML body/testid/title/customer+business blocks/items table with Refund Mode+Amount/Total Refund testid/amount in words; render_invoice_pdf for refund returns valid %PDF; regression that booking+gst_invoice still routes to build_html (TAX INVOICE), partner routes to build_partner_html, withdrawal still uses generic template. Did NOT attempt the live mongo cancel_booking end-to-end flow (local azoapp_local seeding + JWT mint) because the unit-level invariants fully cover the request and the public /api/invoices/pub/{id}/html endpoint directly calls build_invoice_html, which is already exercised.
critical_code_review_comments: build_refund_html correctly uses refund_amount (fallback to total_amount) and the shared _css(ac) + _brand_html, keeping the layout visually identical to the booking (GST) invoice. Looks consistent with build_partner_html style.
Minor: refund HTML calls logo_to_data_uri(biz.logo) twice (once in `logo` local, again inline in _brand_html call). Harmless but can be refactored.

Minor: build_refund_html does not render a QR block ( is empty), while booking invoice shows a verify QR. If parity with the booking invoice is desired, consider rendering _qr_data_uri(verify_url) here too.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refund invoice refactor shipped: build_invoice_html routes invoice_type=='refund' to gst_invoice_service.build_refund_html. New testids: body=refund-invoice, page=refund-invoice-page, total=refund-invoice-total. Title 'REFUND RECEIPT'. Items table columns: Items / Refund Mode / Amount. Total Refund equals abs(refund_amount or total_amount). Tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_refund_invoice_html.py and must be run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var set (conftest requires it, even for pure unit tests).
